description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git checkout behavior, specifically testing how untracked, directory, symlink, and ignored files are handled during checkout operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command must fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether a path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_symlink
methods.description: Checks whether a path is a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a git commit with specified contents.
